entry.title: New: Resolution 106 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM THE DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT(S) AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT(S)

Transfers $5,212 from the Parks and Recreation Administration Other Current Expenses account to the Animal Control account to provide a grant to Action 4 Animals to support its rehoming and adoption programs for at-risk animals.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 106-25 & FC-33 - 04/16/25
